look: 手工毛毡玩偶定格动画风格，绒面毛毡质感，柔和高光与浅景深微距感。
setting: 角色1抱着竹篮站在画面中央，面前的地上散落着一堆彩色筹码；之后的每只兔子都在自己的入场事件时才提着竹篮从画面右侧走进来，走到筹码边停下，石化后就定在原地。
scene: 桌面微缩布景：麻布台面上铺着一块暗红色地毯，地毯周围立着几盏彩色的小蘑菇灯。
light_text: 夜里的桌面微缩布景，唯一光源是布景中几盏小蘑菇灯的暖橙色柔光，光线柔和温暖，背景自然虚化。
constraints: 全片三段生成：第一段角色1与角色2；第二段先用一拍「两尊石像静止不动」锚定开场（与续接引导帧内容一致），再接角色3与角色4；第三段角色4先在中景里石化，然后「镜头拉高俯拍石像原野」单独作为最后一拍（硬切全景）。任意时刻画面里只有一只活着的兔子；其余兔子——前景或背景——全是灰色的石像，保持着停下时的姿势、竹篮与价签原地不动，石像绝不复活。未到入场事件的角色绝不提前出现在画面里。价签是剧情必需道具：角色1 $100、角色2 $50、角色3 $25、角色4 $1，活兔与石像身上的价签都要始终清楚可读（大大的木牌）。最后镜头缓缓拉高升起，俯拍整片铺满地面的灰色石像群像，每一只都已经是石化的，地上只剩几枚筹码。前两段镜头平稳。台词与收尾节拍必须完整落在续接重叠之后。哭喊短促不拖长气声；角色2与角色3的喊话是兴奋而不是怒斥，语速偏快；角色4那句是平静的陈述，语速慢。不出现字幕、气泡与文字。
source_script:
角色1动作：角色1抱着竹篮站在那堆筹码前面，低头盯着地上的筹码，伸出一只爪子想去捡，泪水从脸上滑下来。
角色1：啊啊啊！
角色1动作：角色1的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着伸手够筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色2入场：角色2提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，径直走到那堆筹码前面。
角色2：市场血流成河，正是抄底好时机！
角色2动作：角色2蹲下身，把竹篮口贴着地面，一枚一枚把筹码拨进篮子里。
角色2动作：角色2的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着蹲着拨筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色1动作：角色1与角色2的两尊灰色石像保持着伸手和蹲着的姿势，一动不动地在原地静止片刻。
角色3入场：角色3提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，在那两尊石像旁边停下。
角色3：跌到二十五了，遍地黄金！
角色3动作：角色3蹲下来，把地上的筹码一枚一枚拨进自己的竹篮。
角色3动作：角色3的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着蹲着拨筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色4入场：角色4提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进来，走到那排石像前面停下。
角色4：……市场血流成河，恐慌情绪蔓延。
角色4动作：角色4蹲下身，把竹篮口伸向地上仅剩的几枚筹码。
角色4动作：角色4的身体从爪子开始发硬，一层层变成灰色的石像，保持着蹲着够筹码的姿势定在原地。
角色4动作：镜头从这排石像缓缓拉高升起，俯拍地毯上四尊灰色的石像和远处铺满地面的石像原野，每一只都已经是石化的。

execution.look: Handmade felt-puppet stop-motion style, fuzzy felt surface texture, soft highlights and a shallow-focus macro feel.
execution.setting: Character 1 stands at the center of the frame with a woven basket, a scatter of colored chips on the ground in front of it; each later buyer walks in from the right edge carrying a woven basket at its own entrance event, stops at the chips, and stands turned to stone exactly where it stopped.
execution.scene: A tabletop miniature set: a dark red rug laid over a burlap cloth surface, with a few small colorful mushroom lamps standing around it.
execution.light: A tabletop miniature set at night, lit only by the warm orange glow of small mushroom lamps inside the set; the light is soft and warm and the background falls out of focus.
execution.visible_state: At any moment the frame holds exactly one living white felt rabbit - the current buyer carrying a woven basket; every other rabbit anywhere in the frame, foreground or background, is a gray stone figure frozen in its final pose with its woven basket and its wooden price tag held exactly in place, staying perfectly still through every later scene. The living rabbit is the only rabbit that walks, speaks and picks up chips; rabbits waiting for their entrance event stay outside the frame until that event walks them in from the right. Colored chips lie scattered on the dark red rug around the figures.

directions.event_001: Character 1 is the only rabbit in the frame, standing at the center in front of the scattered chips with one woven basket in the paw, lowering the head toward the chips and reaching the other paw down toward the nearest chip as tears run down the face; a large wooden price tag reading $100 hangs clearly at the chest.
directions.event_003: Character 1's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the reaching pose staying fixed, the woven basket and the $100 price tag held in place.
directions.event_004: Character 2 walks in from the right edge of the frame carrying one woven basket, the only living rabbit in the frame while the gray stone figure of Character 1 stands frozen mid-reach wearing the $100 price tag, and stops at the edge of the chips with a large wooden price tag reading $50 hanging clearly at the chest.
directions.event_006: Character 2 squats down, pushes the mouth of the woven basket along the ground and sweeps the scattered chips into it one by one until a small heap of chips sits inside.
directions.event_007: Character 2's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the squatting pose staying fixed, the loaded basket and the $50 price tag held in place.
directions.event_008: Character 1's gray stone figure, frozen mid-reach with the $100 price tag, and Character 2's gray stone figure, frozen in the squatting pose with the loaded woven basket and the $50 price tag, stand perfectly still and unchanged for a quiet beat, the colored chips lying untouched on the rug between the two stone figures and the right edge of the frame.
directions.event_009: Character 3 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket, the only living rabbit in the frame while the two gray stone figures stand frozen along the left wearing the $100 and the $50 price tags, and stops beside them at the edge of the chips with a large wooden price tag reading $25 hanging clearly at the chest.
directions.event_011: Character 3 squats down beside the two stone figures and sweeps the chips on the ground into the woven basket with a paw, one chip at a time.
directions.event_012: Character 3's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure, the squatting pose staying fixed, the woven basket and the $25 price tag held in place.
directions.event_013: Character 4 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket, the only living rabbit in the frame while the three gray stone figures stand frozen in a row along the left wearing the $100, the $50 and the $25 price tags, and stops in front of them at the edge of the chips with a large wooden price tag reading $1 hanging clearly at the chest.
directions.event_015: Character 4, the only living rabbit left, stands in front of the row of three gray stone figures with the woven basket in the paw, then squats down and pushes the basket mouth along the ground toward the last few colored chips.
directions.event_016: Character 4's body hardens from the paws upward into a gray stone figure in the same medium framing, the squatting pose staying fixed, the woven basket and the $1 price tag held in place, so the row now holds four gray stone figures.
directions.event_017: Character 4's gray stone figure stays frozen exactly as it is while the camera slowly rises and pulls back to a high overhead view of the dark red rug: the four gray stone figures of the buyers stand in a row - the $100 figure frozen mid-reach, the $50 and $25 figures frozen mid-sweep with their woven baskets, and the $1 figure frozen at the last few chips - their large wooden price tags facing up and clearly readable, and beyond the row a whole field of gray stone rabbit figures with wooden price tags covers the ground far into the distance, every single one of them turned to stone, with a few colored chips left scattered on the rug.
